Entries.Text: Measures the distance between two points in the viewport. Place the points by clicking on what the viewport shows, then click a point's sphere to move it with the gizmo. The ruler isn't saved with the map.
Place both points of the ruler in the viewport.
Click in the viewport to place the start point, then again to place the end point. Points land on the surface under the cursor.
Stop placing points, keeping those already placed.
Click in the viewport to place the start point.
Click in the viewport to place the end point.
Nothing was under the cursor. Click on a surface to place the point.
The distance from the start point to the end point, in metres.
Place both points to see the distance.
The start point of the ruler, in world coordinates.
The end point of the ruler, in world coordinates.
The point's world position. Drag or type to move it.
Click in the viewport to place this point on the surface under the cursor.
Puts the viewport gizmo on this point, so it can be dragged. Clicking the point's sphere in the viewport does the same; clicking elsewhere lets it go.
Move this point to the position of the selected map object, or the average position of the selected objects.
How the ruler is drawn in the viewport.
The radius of the point spheres, in metres.
The colour of the line, the points and the distance label.
The colour of the point the gizmo is on.
Show the distance in metres beside the middle of the line.
